nodes.label: The Structure 是……的: Emphasizing Time, Place, Manner
Grammar Pattern: 是……的 (Emphasizing Time/Place/Manner of a Past Event)
Grammar: 是……的 Emphasizing the Agent
Grammar: 不是……的 (negative form of 是……的; 不 goes before 是, and 是 cannot be omitted in negative sentences)
Grammar: omitting 是 in 是……的 (是 can be omitted in positive and interrogative sentences, but not in negative sentences)
Grammar: "是……的"句：强调施事 (The Structure "是……的": used to emphasize the agent of an action) - Lesson 4 grammar point (listed in Contents)
